finding: A reader can expect no pre-commit configuration after setup, then find a generated file. The pre-commit row says init-factory adds nothing to .pre-commit-config.yaml. On first install, handle_precommit creates the file with the factory hooks when it is absent (packages/factory/scripts/init-factory:3241-3250). Fix the row to say that test-command detection adds no test hook.
why_this_severity: The row still tells users when their tests run (no to fails_purpose). The broader claim can cost time checking why setup created the hook configuration.
